title: France — CNES GEIPAN public case catalogue
description: Official searchable French case catalogue, including classification and observation dates. This record represents a collection, not an individual sighting.
evidenceStatus: official catalogue; individual reports and interpretations not independently verified

title: Brazil — Arquivo Nacional OVNI collection
description: Brazilian National Archives describes a UFO-related archival collection of 743 records spanning 1952–2016; 743 is the publisher's collection count, not imported individual cases.
evidenceStatus: official collection; individual claims not independently verified

title: Chile — DGAC SEFAA resolved cases index
description: Chilean aviation authority's SEFAA publishes lists of resolved anomalous-aerial-phenomena cases by year. This is a catalogue reference, not a count of individually reviewed cases.
evidenceStatus: official case catalogue; case outcomes vary

title: New Zealand — NZDF released UFO correspondence files
description: NZDF confirms its 2010 release of fifteen redacted correspondence volumes covering reports from 1952–2009. This entry describes the collection, not fifteen sightings.
evidenceStatus: official correspondence collection; individual claims not independently verified
